patthana17.22:1.1: kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca vipāka dhammadhammo na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana17.22:2.1: vipāka dhammadhammaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na vipāka dhammadhammo na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. nevavipāka na vipāka dhammadhammaṃ
patthana17.22:3.1: abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nevavipāka na vipāka dhammadhammo na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
